packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Major upgrades always need manual review
Postgres image: one PR across dev, deploy and CI
A Postgres major bump needs a data migration, not a tag change
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Postgres major upgrade.** Changing the tag alone does not migrate the data: the new server refuses to start on the old cluster. Plan the move first (see `docs/adr/0012-postgres-major-upgrade-by-dump-and-restore.md`); `deploy/upgrade-postgres.sh` only covers 16 → 18.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions digest bumps into one PR
Group the Elixir/OTP toolchain (Dockerfiles + CI) together
Elixir/OTP/Debian versions come from the `# renovate:` annotations (custom manager below); ignore the composite Dockerfile image tags the docker manager can't decompose
go-pmtiles: tags are v-prefixed; a bump also needs both SHA256 args in the Dockerfiles, so it is never auto-merged
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Update `PMTILES_SHA256_AMD64` / `PMTILES_SHA256_ARM64` in `app/Dockerfile` and `app/Dockerfile.dev` from the release's `checksums.txt` — the image build fails on a stale checksum.

packageRules.description: typst: tags are v-prefixed; a bump also needs both SHA256 args in the Dockerfiles, so it is never auto-merged
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Update `TYPST_SHA256_AMD64` / `TYPST_SHA256_ARM64` in `app/Dockerfile` and `app/Dockerfile.dev`, and `TYPST_SHA256` in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, from the release assets' sha256 digests — the image build fails on a stale checksum. Then download a membership PDF from the Postfach: the template (`app/priv/pdf/aufnahmeantrag.typ`) may need changes for a new Typst version.

customManagers.description: Update versions annotated with `# renovate:` comments (Elixir/OTP/Debian in Dockerfiles + CI)
